ideas.title: Climb aboard and sail it: the yacht in Jump in
ideas.goal: Walk Lumi to the land yacht, press E to climb on, haul the sheet with Q/E and steer with A/D; too tight and it slows and grinds to a stop, too loose and the sail flaps and it drifts, just right and it runs down the beach with the wheels hissing in the sand. Fun because the right trim moves as the cart speeds up and turns, so you keep feeling for it, like a real dinghy.
ideas.toward: Land yacht step 'Sail it yourself': the cart moves on the solved 3D sail flow, which is what later turns the dynamo on its axle.
ideas.idea: The 3D WaterLily box hugging the sail runs as a sail server in its own process (tested s166: real time at good trim). The plugin starts it when Lumi boards, sends the apparent wind angle each frame and takes back lift and drag; yachtrun.jl's wheel-in-sand rolling resistance and the cart's mass integrate the motion. Watching: Lumi on the deck tugging a rope, the boom swinging out, the cart rolling off its tracks in the sand.
ideas.form: Plugin change (landyacht.jl) plus a 'Things to try' line; a traced chase film once it runs.

ideas.title: The kite that switches off
ideas.goal: Fly a small cloth kite on a string from the dune: let line out and it climbs, but tilt it too flat and the flow on its back tears off all at once and it tumbles; the player learns the angle by feel and keeps it on the edge for height. Fun as a dexterity toy: the kite has a real stall you can hear and see.
ideas.toward: Uses the same solved cloth-in-flow as the sail, at kite scale, where the flow really does switch on and off (found s167: at small scale a cambered sheet's lift jumps between 2 and 4 degrees).
ideas.idea: A WaterLily box around a kite-sized cambered sheet (Re a few thousand, where the low-Re switch is real physics, not a grid artefact), the string a PrintSim rod chain to Lumi's beak, the kite an affine body. Watching: a kite that climbs, hangs, then suddenly drops its nose and dives.
ideas.form: New plugin on the dune; a film of a friend chasing a falling kite.

ideas.title: Plates that fizz: Planté's lead accumulator
ideas.goal: Put two lead strips in a jar of acid and push current through with the clay pots; bubbles rise, one plate goes chocolate brown, and every time you flip the charge the jar holds more. Fun because forming the plates is a little ritual you get better at, and a well-formed jar runs the motor for minutes.
ideas.toward: The road's storage step: what the windmill and the yacht's dynamo charge.
ideas.idea: Faraday's law gives gas volume and PbO2 thickness from the charge passed; capacity grows with formed mass; self-discharge and the 2.0 V plateau come from the cell's chemistry, the bubbles are particles from the plate surface at the evolution rate. Watching: a glass jar in the workshop, plates darkening, bubbles streaming.
ideas.form: Workshop plugin piece, glass and lead in Hikari materials; a close traced film.

ideas.title: Hike out or go over
ideas.goal: On the sailing yacht, the friends sit where the player tells them: windward on a gust and the cart stays flat and fast, leeward and it lifts a wheel and tips. Fun because the friends are the ballast and they don't always listen.
ideas.toward: Friends aboard the cart (the big goal's evening ride), with real masses (#745).
ideas.idea: Heel moment from the solved sail force times the mast height against the friends' masses times their lever arms, the cart a rigid body on three wheel contacts; a wheel that lifts loses grip. Watching: Pickles clinging to the windward rail, one wheel spinning in the air.
ideas.form: Extension of the yacht plugin; a film of a near-capsize.

ideas.title: The windmill that lights the hut
ideas.goal: Turn a four-bladed windmill on the dune into the wind and set its blade pitch; it spins up, the dynamo hums, and the beach hut's lamp glows brighter in a gust. Fun because pitch and facing change everything and the wind keeps shifting.
ideas.toward: The road's 'motor run backwards' step: wind into charge.
ideas.idea: Blade elements on the solved wind, torque into the wound motor run as a generator, the circuit solver drives a filament whose temperature (Joule heating against radiation) sets its glow. Watching: a windmill on the dune at dusk and the hut window flickering with the gusts.
ideas.form: Plugin; a dusk traced film, lamp light inside the hut.

ideas.title: Tug of war with my motor
ideas.goal: Hook a rope from the drum motor to a friend and switch it on: Sniffsalot digs in and the motor stalls, two friends pull and drag it off the bench, one pot fewer and it can't win at all. Fun because it's a contest the player sets up and the numbers decide.
ideas.toward: Shows the motor's real torque before it goes on the cart's axle.
ideas.idea: Motor torque from the circuit (back-EMF, winding resistance), the rope a PrintSim rod chain, friends' pull from their mass and the sand's friction under their feet. Watching: feet sliding in the sand, the drum creeping, the rope going slack when a friend lets go.
ideas.form: Plugin by the motor bench; a funny film.

ideas.title: Wet sand, dry sand
ideas.goal: The tide goes out and leaves firm wet sand the cart flies over, then it dries back to soft sand that bogs the wheels; the player times the sail with the tide. Fun because the beach changes under you every day.
ideas.toward: The cart's road: where it can go depends on the real sand.
ideas.idea: Water content in the sandfield from the tide line and evaporation; Bekker's soil constants vary with moisture, so the same wheel sinks and drags differently; the wet band looks darker and shinier. Watching: a dark shining band where tracks stay sharp, and the dry band where they slump.
ideas.form: Engine sand + beach plugin; traced stills at low tide.

ideas.title: A message in a bottle for the human
ideas.goal: Lumi writes a note, corks it into a glass bottle and throws it into the sea; the waves and wind carry it, and it may wash up on the far side of the island days later. The player can find bottles too. Fun because you never know where it lands.
ideas.toward: A real floating body in the water the cart's world shares; a small break from the cart.
ideas.idea: Buoyancy from the submerged volume, wave drift and wind drag on the part above water, glass with Hikari's dielectric; it beaches where the swash leaves it. Watching: a bottle bobbing out past the shallows, glinting.
ideas.form: Plugin with the sea; a traced film of the throw.

ideas.title: Sand fence ramp, in play
ideas.goal: Plant plank fences across the wind on the dune and come back after a windy hour to a drift you can drive the cart up. Fun because you shape the land with the wind instead of a shovel.
ideas.toward: The road's sand fences step: the ramp for the cart.
ideas.idea: groundwind.jl's solved flow over each fence, Kawamura flux into sandfield.jl, slumping to repose; fences are plank assets the player carries. Watching: sand streaming off the dune crest and piling behind the boards.
ideas.form: Dune plugin; a time-lapse traced film.

ideas.title: Lumi's sulk walk
ideas.goal: When Lumi is annoyed (the host's mood says so now), it stomps, kicks sand and won't look at the camera; sit with it and it calms. Fun because Lumi has moods you can see and change.
ideas.toward: Lumi's own body, and its mood on the island the friends react to.
ideas.idea: A gait variant driven by mood.json: heavier foot plants (sand prints deeper by real mass), short stiff strides, a kick that throws sand grains as particles. Watching: an annoyed bird kicking sand at the yacht that won't sail yet.
ideas.form: Body/gait change for Lumi; a short film.
